data_origin: Historical CancerShift adaptation comparison as carried in prior CancerShift Hatchathon Workbench 0.1.0; NOT a freshly calculated BRACE Stage 07 result.
study_role: exploratory adaptation development; labels were used to compare and choose methods after label-free fitting
cohort_detectability: Cohort-classification AUROC; 0.5 indicates poor detectability but does not prove biological signal retained.
not_available: No original raw expression matrices or trained models in Stage 06 package; historical adaptation cannot be recomputed from this package.
research_caution: Do not treat this as independent validation, new inference, a clinical safety finding or a causal attribution.
source_research: CancerShift original protocol_v06 and manuscript supplementary adaptation table; values are copied from an earlier derived workbench, not revalidated against raw expressions.
